messages:
maria (docs): Starting a short thread — I opened a draft PR for the v1->v2 deprecation guide and sample-app changes. link: https://repo.internal/redwood/docs/pull/482
ken (sdk): Thanks. Can you call out the SDK-breaking change for the `models` param rename? Need exact code snippets we want users to copy.
sara (product): Also flag the model-swap behavior: fallback to `compatible-variant` when exact alias missing. We promised customers a smooth fallback in the notice.
aj (eng): Quick heads up — runtime will still accept v1 tokens for 90 days after the cut, but we’ll return a deprecation header. Docs should show the header and the recommended migration check: `x-rw-deprecated: v1-legacy`
luis (support): We’ve already triaged ~5 support tickets that assumed alias mapping would be preserved. Can we add a small troubleshooting section with exact error messages?
maria (docs): Good call. Draft includes a Troubleshooting section and example errors. Pulling a snippet now.
maria (docs): ```
# old client v1
client.generate({ model: "redwood/cheddar-v1", prompt: "..." })

# new client v2
const resp = await client.responses.create({ model: "redwood/cheddar-v2", input: "..." })
```
ken (sdk): That looks fine. Also add the alias map helper we added in SDK v2: `aliasMap.migrate(oldName)` and an example for batch embeddings change (param rename `input` -> `texts`).
sara (product): Add a short user-story example showing a production deploy rollback plan: how to detect the deprecation header and automatically route to `redwood/cheddar-compat` until you finish the migration.
aj (eng): Suggest adding an ops note: if you depend on pinned model SHA, include snippet to lock both alias and sha. E.g.: `model: "redwood/cheddar@sha:abcdef"`
maria (docs): I added a checklist in the PR description: (1) validate SDK snippet with ken; (2) add sample-app changes and run smoke tests; (3) include support FAQ and template reply; (4) confirm rollout windows with infra.
luis (support): Can you paste the FAQ template here? I can start copying it into shared responses.
maria (docs): FAQ template: "If you see `error: alias not found` after the sunset, check your client for `models`/`model` param, verify alias in the model catalog, and use `aliasMap.migrate()` for bulk updates."
ken (sdk): I'll add a tiny code example for `aliasMap.migrate()` and send a short test script.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: docs-site:main -> staging at 2024-12-09T18:00:00Z
sara (product): One more thing — wording: avoid saying "breaking" in public migration notice; use "sunset" + "required changes". internal docs can use stronger language.
maria (docs): Good catch, will keep public copy softer. Internal deprecation notice will be stronger and reference support SLAs.
aj (eng): FYI, we plan to enable the new header in prod at cut + 7 days for telemetry. Put that date in internal notes.
maria (docs): Updated PR with all snippets and a small sample-app patch that toggles `model` -> `responses.create`. CI smoke tests on sample-app passed locally. Link: https://repo.internal/redwood/samples/pull/210
luis (support): Copying the sample-app link into our KB now. Thanks!
ken (sdk): Sending a tiny patch to SDK branch to add the migration helper and an integration test. PR: https://repo.internal/redwood/sdk/pull/769
maria (docs): Can folks review the docs PR by EOD PST? I plan to ship the public migration notice tomorrow AM if no objections.
sara (product): Reviewed and left two nits. none blocking.
aj (eng): LGTM for technical accuracy.
luis (support): Looks good from support perspective.
ken (sdk): Approved after CI green.
maria (docs): Perfect — merging in 10m unless someone yells. Thanks all :)
